Cardiology consultation

Chest Pain Clinic

The Chest Pain Clinic provides assessment for patients with chest discomfort or symptoms that may be related to heart disease. Patients may be referred after an Emergency Department visit or by another physician.

What to Expect

  • You will be seen by one of our clinic physicians.
  • Before your appointment, you may have an electrocardiogram (ECG).
  • During the visit, the physician will review your symptoms, medical history, and available test results.
  • Additional tests may be ordered if clinically appropriate, such as a stress test, Holter or event monitor, or cardiac imaging.
  • The physician will discuss recommended next steps for your care. Some results may require follow-up outside the hospital clinic.
